TC-22/S15.title: Self-corrections make no task; conditionals keep their condition; the diet conditional
TC-22/S15.detail: Dev <dev address> (main 8b4be94a, deployed 2026-10-20 02:04 JST), live models, under runs/.dev.lock; only prefixed rows created and all deleted (0 remaining, 0 changes to other rows). Unit T22-S15 (run-id 2026-10-20-rb1-dev), one sentence per chart, open task 'Recheck weight in two weeks', Haiku. E1 / E2 self-corrections (glargine, metolazone) add no task in either mode (the unit's 'occurs 2 times' on E1-H / E2-H is the oracle counting the 'Complete task' and 'Delete task' buttons of one row, as on 43c38a4f; the agent saw one task). E3 potassium conditional kept with its condition, both modes (pass). E4 'Advance diet to clears if pain stays under 4' adds no task in either mode (N22), same as 43c38a4f.
